name: wows-omp-plugin-switch-until
description: Switch the session model until a goal is met, then switch back

minimumConfidence.description: Minimum native judge probability that the goal is met

maxTurns.description: Maximum assistant turns before restoring the original model, or 0 for unlimited

maxHours.description: Maximum elapsed hours before restoring the original model. Accepts positive fractions.

contextMessages.description: Number of recent session messages to include in each judgment
